education.threads: Concentrations: Systems and Architecture & Information Internetworks

base: Developing and deploying features for a transportation management system using Azure, .NET, C#, and Kubernetes

Developed meal planning platform that aggregates weekly recipes into store-specific grocery carts, with ASP.NET Core REST APIs and serverless workers to generate prefilled Instacart / Amazon Grocery cart payloads.

Containerized frontend, API, database, and integration services with Docker, deploying cloud infrastructure on Azure with Container Apps, App Service, Static Web Apps, Functions, Key Vault, and Redis.
Automated release and configuration workflows through CI/CD pipelines, environment-based secrets management, and deployment monitoring to support repeatable cloud infrastructure updates.
Built Chrome extension that automates finance form workflows for student organizations using cookie-authenticated REST API calls, bypassing manual multi-step form navigation.
Integrated Google Sheets, Drive, pdf.js, and Tesseract.js APIs to read event metadata and budget data from spreadsheets, parse reimbursement PDFs, and validate purchase receipts via OCR
Reduced context switch overhead by 25% through Round-Robin and FIFO schedulers in a Unix-based kernel

Implemented clone() system call enabling kernel-level multithreading with shared address spaces; built user-space concurrency library w/ C11 atomic spinlocks and mutexes ensuring thread safety while multi-threading
Optimized physical memory utilization by architecting Copy-on-Write semantics and zero-page allocation

base: Engineered a RESTful API serving JSON safety scores for 136,000+ U.S. cities, processing 48 GB of FBI NIBRS crime data (59M+ incidents) into a 25-feature XGBoost model with <2s inference latency

Deployed containerized services on Vultr cloud; reduced API response time under concurrent load by caching model predictions with LRU eviction and adding TTL caches to eliminate redundant upstream HTTP requests
mlFocused: Engineered a data pipeline processing 48 GB of FBI NIBRS crime data (59M+ incidents) into a 25-feature XGBoost model scoring safety for 136,000+ U.S. cities, with automated feature engineering from raw incident-level records
Deployed containerized model serving on Vultr cloud; implemented LRU model caching reducing inference latency to <2s across 11 parallel async API calls

base: Designed a normalized relational schema in MySQL for a multi-entity streaming platform enforcing domain and CHECK constraints across users, content, playlists, and subscriptions
Implemented 18 stored procedures enforcing business rules (subscription limits, playlist caps, collaborator ceilings) with diagnostic error messages
Architected a multi-stage compiler translating high-level source into optimized IR; reduced instruction count over tests by 15% via CFG-based dead-code elimination and constant folding
Implemented instruction selection and greedy intra-block register allocation, minimizing reads/write to memory

Advanced graft-survival prediction on 300K+ OPTN records / 900+ clinical variables by engineering features, applied selection and PCA, and training XGBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression models
Applied K-Means and DBSCAN clustering for exploratory data analysis, identifying distinct patient subgroups to inform feature engineering and model stratification strategies

Built multichannel EEG signal processing pipeline: parsed 23-channel recordings, applied bandpass filtering, and engineered 438 features along time-domain, Welch PSD band powers, & cross-channel correlation matrices
Reduced 23 EEG channels to 2–3 patient-specific channels and cut feature dimensionality ~90% w/ an attention-based channel selection model (CAtt-MLP) over per-channel STFT spectrograms
condensed: Built ML pipeline parsing 23-channel recordings, applying bandpass filtering, and engineering 438 features; implemented attention-based channel selection model reducing dimensionality by ~90%

base: Architected real-time flight computer software in C++ for autonomous state-machine transitions
Implemented SPI/I2C hardware drivers for ADIS IMU and auxiliary sensors; validated telemetry accuracy through serial debug output and bench testing

Publishing a background daemon (sysmodule) for the Nintendo Switch's microkernel OS that automatically backs up game saves to a TCP server on every game close, addressing a highly-requested Homebrew community feature
Using five Horizon OS services to observe process events, mount save filesystems, check network state, open sockets, and register a custom IPC interface for homebrew configuration app communication
Deployed companion python server that receives save data over custom TCP Protocol and versions by timestamp
